pr_title: Implement ADR 0110 humanoid profiles and motion
pr_body: Implements ADR 0110 in staged dispatcher requests. This stage adds engine-animation profile validation and conservative import-time name/convention detection over stable BoneIds, including ancestry-based chain validation that permits helper/twist bones and non-blocking ambiguity diagnostics. The previous stage added the persisted model-owned profile contract. Follow-up stages add portable HumanoidMotion conversion/baking, imported variants, Animation Set source selection, editor configuration, target resolution, and packaging.
